chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurara and Al-Fadl, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was Ascended to the sky, he reached the Frequented House (Bayt Al-Mamour), and the time for prayer arrived, so Jibril called the Adhan and the Iqamah. Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) moved forward, and the Angels and the Prophets formed rows behind Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.أَقَامَ: Called the Iqamah (call to establish prayer)

ai.seo_question: What happened during the Prophet's ascension to the heavens regarding the call to prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the primacy of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) by depicting him leading all Angels and previous Prophets in prayer during the Mi'raj, a key narrative in Shia exegesis affirming his universal leadership (Imamah). The presence of Jibril performing the Adhan and Iqamah establishes the divine origin of these ritual calls, linking the celestial worship directly to earthly practice. This event serves as a theological foundation for the superiority of the Prophet's prayer and the continuity of prophetic tradition.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Zurara and Al Fazl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When Rasool-Allahsaww was Ascended with to the sky, so hesaww reached [52:4] the frequented House (Bayt Al-Mamour), and the Salāt presented itself, Jibraeelas called the Azān and the Iqamah. So Rasool-Allahsaww moved forward (to lead), and the Angels and the Prophetsas formed rows behind Muhammadsaww’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ’Udhaynah from Zurarah from and al-Fadl who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When the Messenger of Allah was taken to the heaven upon his arrival in Bayt al-Ma‘mur at the time of Salah (prayer), Jibril (Gabriel) said Adhan and Iqamah. The Messenger of Allah went ahead to lead and the angels and prophets lined up behind Prophet Muhammad for prayer.”’
